business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

change_fees_usd.description: Sum of the recorded change fees on the changeable itineraries.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_week.description: Monday of the first open, conflict-free venue week on or after standard ticket confirmation (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the rush queue saves after the venue calendar and attendee conflicts are reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40318.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered ITINERARY that the external recovery must cover.

group_fare_usd.description: Group fare per new ticket on the group desk's confirmation.

incremental_travel_cost_usd.description: Change fees plus new tickets at the group fare, before any rush fee.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: basic-fare itineraries that cannot be changed and are forfeited on a move

local_attendees.description: Required attendees whose home office is the venue's local office and who need no itinerary.

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for existing itineraries of the required travellers that can be re-issued to the new week before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: ITINERARY.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing standard_ticketing_next_clear_week, rush_ticketing_into_22_june_week, rebook_everyone_at_open_fares_via_northlane.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_attendees.description: People flagged required on the event at the current agenda revision.

required_quantity.description: ticketed itineraries required for the six required attendees who travel to Fennimore Hall (ten required, four local to the Bristol hub)

rush_fee_usd.description: Flat rush-queue fee on the group desk's confirmation.

selected_venue_week.description: Venue and week used by the selected option, as VENUE/YYYY-MM-DD.

session_days.description: Session days named by the current agenda revision.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered ITINERARY after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40318.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing basic-fare itineraries that cannot be changed and are forfeited on a move.
